It is the single-repo skill that seeded Cloudflare's fleet-wide vulnerability discovery harness, and it writes independently verified, machine-readable findings to files like findings.json. item.title: [juejin] Cursor 转 Codex 大半个月，聊聊我的真实感受
item.description: A developer who spent the better part of a month on Codex after switching from Cursor says the newer tool feels less like a coding assistant and more like a general-purpose agent that keeps working on its own, while Cursor was his first real taste of AI-assisted coding. It is a personal, hands-on account rather than a benchmark, useful for anyone choosing between the two or tracking how these tools are changing shape.

item.description: Kimi K3.1 Pro has just launched, and community reaction centers on two points: it is faster than K3 and performs close to Opus, yet its quota burns fast enough that some users ran out within ten minutes. Developers planning long or high-frequency calls should budget for quota before benchmark scores.

item.title: [infoq] 又一国产决策模型发布：面向企业高频判断任务，23 项开源基测准确率超过微软和 JEV
item.description: Ant Digital Technologies released LingDT-Decision-1.0 on October 22 in 4B and 27B sizes, aimed at structured enterprise decisions such as intent detection, task classification, tool selection and risk scoring rather than free-form text generation. The company says the 27B version outscores Microsoft-Decision-1, Jev 1.13.0 and Fastino/GLiDE across 23 open benchmarks, with over 90% lower token use and up to 10x faster processing in customer-service and labeling tests. It is free to try for a limit

item.title: [v2ex] [分享创造] 分享一个用 Rust 写的开源 2D CAD： CADCraft
item.description: CADCraft is a free, open-source 2D CAD application written in Rust, running on Windows, macOS, Linux, FreeBSD and WebAssembly. It ships drafting tools such as LINE, CIRCLE, ARC, OFFSET and TRIM, layers and dimensions, DWG/DXF workflows, plus PDF, SVG and PNG export. Its MCP, JSON control and headless CLI let scripts or AI agents create drawings, inspect entities and convert files. It is under active development with MIT or Apache-2.0 licensing.

item.title: [juejin] 面试官问你：“AI 能写 80% 的代码了，公司为什么还需要你？”
item.description: A Juejin post on how 2026 technical interviews differ from two years ago: instead of hand-writing a Promise or explaining React Fiber, interviewers now assume candidates already use AI and ask why a company should still hire them when AI writes 80% of the code. It's aimed at engineers preparing for interviews who need to articulate what AI can't replace.

item.title: [v2ex] [分享发现] 谈谈我的每月 20 美元 AI 工具搭配策略：为什么我停掉了官方 Claude Pro 订阅
item.description: An indie developer lays out an AI tool stack capped at $20 a month, splitting work 90/10: only hard tasks like architecture design and cross-file refactoring go to paid frontier models, while routine scripts and format conversion run on free ones. His paid base is a $19.99/month Google enterprise bundle covering Gemini flagships plus Claude 3.5 Sonnet and Opus quotas. He dropped official Claude Pro over rate limits, peak-hour quality drops and ban risk.

item.title: [v2ex] [OpenAI] team codex 额度 vs GPT PLUS 额度如何？
item.description: A heavy GPT Team user on V2EX describes running several team accounts strung together with cpa for shared use, and even built a self-serve site reselling seats at 85 yuan a month. What he actually wants to know is the real quota for team versus Plus accounts, including whether the rumored $100 a week is accurate; the post offers no answer, and he avoids sub2api over ban worries.

item.title: [v2ex] [分享创造] 我写了个自认为非常牛逼的浏览器插件: StackPrism
item.description: StackPrism is a browser extension that fingerprints the tech stack of whatever page you're on, shipping 35,000+ rules and 130,000+ patterns across 20-plus categories such as frontend frameworks, UI libraries, CDNs, SaaS, analytics and payments. The author built it after Wappalyzer failed to identify some sites; all matching runs offline inside the extension, no page data is uploaded, detection rules are user-extensible, and the source is on GitHub.

item.title: [v2ex] [硬件] 理了一下马斯克和英特尔的公开信息： Terafab + 14A，目前只有「总体框架」，没那么铁

item.description: 36Kr's morning brief rounds up three items: the average price of domestic Chinese large models has risen to 13 yuan, an app formerly called 死了么 published pricing that tops out at 199 yuan a year, and Cambricon posted Q3 net profit of 1.404 billion yuan, up 147.74% year over year. The original is a headline-style digest with no further detail, good for a quick scan of where the industry is moving rather than for deep reading.

item.title: [v2ex] [程序员] 分享 Vibe Coding 作品： AI Vault，多 Agent 技能管理工具+llama.cpp 本地部署工具
item.description: AI Vault manages skills, prompts, MCP servers, models and API keys in one place and pushes them to 49+ agents with one click, with the author stressing that all data stays on your own machine. It also bundles local deployment for llama.cpp, KVMEM and NInfer plus model downloads. It targets people juggling several agents who don't want configs scattered across tools; the author presents it as a Vibe Coding project with docs and video demos.

item.title: [infoq] DeepSeek千亿融资逼近收官：结盟完美世界、中芯聚源等产业资本，募资翻倍押注具身智能
item.description: Bloomberg reports DeepSeek's second round has locked in roughly 100 billion RMB at a pre-money valuation near 500 billion, pushing its total raised past 150 billion RMB in under four months. Tencent and CATL each added about 10 billion, while new money came mainly from hard-tech investors such as SMIC Capital and Geely, and Perfect World disclosed two vehicles that raised 11.17 billion combined.

item.title: [v2ex] [推广] 做了一个生成 Rap 视频的工具，欢迎来玩
item.description: airapreel.com swaps a person in a rap video for someone from your photo: pick a template such as Hotel Lobby or Burning Bridges, upload a picture, and the AI tries to preserve the original motion, scene and camera work with no prompt writing. The author admits results wobble with multiple people, occlusion and frequent cuts, plans to let users upload their own footage, and is running promotional pricing for now.

item.title: [infoq] AI Agent 正在改写 CPU 的价值：当 Token 变成行动，算力竞争不再只是拼 GPU
item.description: Arm's cloud AI solutions architecture director Ravi Malhotra argues that in agentic workloads, CPU performance should no longer be judged mainly by token generation. The CPU has to turn generated tokens into actions such as compiling and testing code, calling tools, hitting databases and isolating sandboxes, while accelerators handle planning. Arm has published an evaluation method covering tool calls, orchestration and end-to-end task execution, developed with Fujitsu, Meta, OpenAI and others.

item.title: [v2ex] [分享创造] 分享一个小项目：把 ripgrep 做成跨平台的单文件 rg.com，还支持 Python / Node.js / Java 调用
item.description: A developer packaged ripgrep as an APE (Actually Portable Executable), producing a single rg.com binary that runs on Windows, Linux and macOS across both x86_64 and ARM64. APEBind then generates uniform call interfaces for Python, Node.js and Java, so scripts can invoke rg without per-platform builds. The same trick produced sympy-ape and tika-ape, letting Java or Node.js call SymPy without Python installed, and Python use Apache Tika without a JVM.

item.title: [infoq] 刘铁岩、诺奖、图灵奖得主等嘉宾共话AI的下一个十年：Transformer一统天下之后，AI的下一张王牌是什么？
item.description: At the opening roundtable of ICAAS 2026, Nobel chemistry laureate Michael Levitt, 2021 Turing winner Jack Dongarra, mathematician Ma Xiao and He Jiyan of Zhongguancun Academy debated where AI goes after the industry converged on Transformer-scale training. Levitt argued for hedging like a cautious banker rather than betting everything on one route; Dongarra pushed for exploring beyond the mainstream and treating failure as part of research. They clashed over whether overpromising could trigger a

item.title: [infoq] 讯飞发布新一代端到端交互模型：语音大模型调用量暴涨20倍，端侧已实现约70%云端能力
item.description: iFlytek unveiled SparkAudio 1.0 on October 22, a speech foundation model that moves past ASR and translation to cover audio understanding, emotion recognition, real-time speaker separation and ambient sound. It also showed the cloud-device Spark X2.6 and a 4B on-device model, Spark-X2.6-4B. iFlytek says speech model calls are up more than 20x year over year and on-device models now handle roughly 70% of cloud capability, with the tech already shipping in iFlytek Input 16.0 for robots, cars and s

item.title: [infoq] 智源众智 FlagOS 2.2 让前沿模型与多元算力协同演进
item.description: FlagOS 2.2 now bundles nine operator libraries covering 1,454 operators, 890 more than the previous release, and reports roughly 27% overall cross-chip performance gains measured across 10 heterogeneous AI chips and over a thousand operators. In one deployment with GLM-5.3-Flash, existing Ascend 910B hardware served 2.04x its previous logical throughput, with rent-equivalent compute cost running 19.4%–27.6% below comparable commercial API pricing.

item.title: [infoq] 上下文语言模型：通过自主管理上下文提升性能、降低计算成本
item.description: Researchers from Meta, MIT and the University of Washington propose Context Language Model, which treats context as a freely rewritable file: the model deletes irrelevant turns, keeps key facts and tracks progress instead of relying on summarization or retrieval. Zero-shot it lifts BrowseComp-Plus accuracy by 11.4% with 21.5% fewer FLOPs, and an RL-trained Qwen3.5-9B climbs from 28.8% to 42.5% on the same benchmark.

item.title: [infoq] PostgreSQL 19 发不出来？AI“找茬”太快，人类修Bug的速度跟不上了
item.description: PostgreSQL 19 slipped from October 29 to November 19, with an extra RC2 on November 12, after roughly 8 to 10 significant features were reverted during beta. Core committer and EDB vice president Peter Eisentraut says the cause is not vibe coding but maturing LLM-assisted code review and fuzzing, which surfaced long-tail defects that would otherwise have trickled in over five years. AI raised the effective quality bar faster than humans can fix bugs.

item.title: [v2ex] [Chrome] 测试一下 Chrome 最新支持的 JXL HDR 图片格式
item.description: Chrome and Firefox have both recently shipped JPEG XL support, so web pages can finally display HDR images using the PQ transfer function directly. The sample images in the post were exported with LocalViewer, an open-source converter that turns JXR and camera RAW files into JXL, JPEG and AVIF HDR variants, including 16-bit float JXL with luminance metadata and base-plus-gain-map JPEG.

item.title: [infoq] 奥特曼最新 45 分钟访谈：一年不写代码、压力大到不想起床，还嫌 ChatGPT 太谄媚
item.description: In a 45-minute interview with AI blogger Matthew Berman, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman said he hasn't looked at a line of code in about a year and expects AI to surface candidate treatments for major diseases within a few years. He argued programmers aren't losing jobs to AI but are busier and earning more, and put his GPU demand at effectively unlimited. The conversation also covered AI consciousness, loss-of-control risk, and the pressure that sometimes keeps him in bed.

item.title: [infoq] 决策模型也有专用推理引擎了：StartLux 开源 Prism，单卡最高提速 5.3 倍
item.description: StartLux has open-sourced Prism, an inference engine built specifically for its StartLux-Decision model. On a single NVIDIA H200 running the 27B model, it claims 1.2x to 5.3x the speed of vLLM, cutting a three-question task on one document from 92.9ms to 17.4ms. Because decision models only score a handful of candidate options rather than generate full text, Prism skips whole-vocabulary output and returns bit-identical results regardless of batching; accuracy was 92.94% against 92.97% in BF16.

item.title: [hackernews] eMudhra intermediate CA compromise
item.description: A Mozilla security blog post and Bugzilla bug 2083449 cover a compromise of an intermediate CA run by eMudhra. When an intermediate certificate authority is compromised, every certificate it issued has to be treated as suspect, which bears directly on the public trust chain browsers rely on. The linked pages aren't summarized here; details beyond the title aren't available.

item.title: [hackernews] Eight Bits of Trust: eMudhra's CA keys cracked in milliseconds
item.description: Scott Helme recovered the private keys of eight eMudhra intermediate certificates straight from their public certificates in under a second, because the keys were tiny integers such as 4, 56 and 115. The compromise was reported to Apple, Google, Microsoft, Mozilla and eMudhra on 17 October; Chrome shipped a CRLSet block that evening and Firefox followed hours later through OneCRL.

item.title: [hackernews] Show HN: SimCity, but with Permits
item.description: A free browser-based city builder where you play mayor: you know what the city needs, but every plan has to survive the zoning board, the neighbors, the appeals court, and the next election. It layers bureaucratic satire on the familiar SimCity loop, which should appeal to anyone who has played city sims and watched permitting grind a good idea to a halt.

item.title: [github_trending] NVIDIA/OpenShell
item.description: NVIDIA has open-sourced OpenShell, described as a safe, private runtime for fleets of autonomous AI agents, Apache-2.0 licensed and published on PyPI. The 0.1.x line adds a stable release cadence, new isolation primitives, an expanded extension surface and new APIs. It targets teams that need to run many agents inside an isolated, private environment.

item.title: [juejin] 从codex转战workbuddy使用一周的感受
item.description: A long-time Codex user documents a week of switching to WorkBuddy, Tencent's agentic coding tool, covering why he moved, the problems he ran into and the money he saved. He frames it as a personal usage log rather than an ad or a hit piece, which makes it worth reading for developers comparing coding agents or thinking about leaving Codex.

item.title: [github_trending] pbakaus/impeccable
item.description: Impeccable is a design guidance package for AI coding agents: one skill, 24 commands, live browser iteration and 62 deterministic detector rules, installed with npx impeccable install and initialized via /impeccable init. It builds on Anthropic's frontend-design skill and records product truth in PRODUCT.md to suppress the usual tells, such as Inter everywhere, purple-to-blue gradients and cards nested in cards. Useful for developers whose AI-written frontends all look alike.

item.title: [github_trending] Nutlope/hallmark
item.description: Hallmark, made by Together AI, is a design skill for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode that deals three themes from a 48-theme catalog, then lints the build in a real browser against machine-made tells like eyebrows above headings or one coloured word in a headline. Gates come in tiers: a Floor covering contrast, focus, reduced motion and invented facts that never ships, overridable Reflex defaults, and a fresh-context reviewer with the last word.

item.description: Nobel laureate Hassabis has predicted that AGI could arrive in as little as two years, and this Zhihu thread asks readers how to weigh that timeline. The linked page isn't summarized here; the context and reasoning behind the claim aren't available beyond the title.

item.title: [github_trending] makecindy/cindy
item.description: Cindy is an Apache-2.0 open-source AI agent that bundles multiple harnesses, models and tools into a single agent doing real work inside your own projects and apps, running on Node.js 22.x and pnpm 10, downloadable from cindy.app. It pitches itself as ready from day one rather than a framework you assemble, which suits developers who want an agent on their own machine without the setup work.

item.title: [juejin] 公司从 400 多人缩减到 100 多人，我开始重新思考程序员的未来
item.description: A personal essay on Juejin whose author watched their company shrink from over 400 people to just over 100, and uses that to rethink the future of programmers, touching on the situation of 35-year-old developers and the combined pressure of a weak market and AI. It is not a technical tutorial but one developer's read on an industry in retreat, useful for anyone weighing career plans.

item.title: [github_trending] luongnv89/claude-howto
item.description: luongnv89/claude-howto is an MIT-licensed, example-driven guide to Claude Code, currently at version 2.1.302 and targeting Claude Code 2.1+. It walks from basic concepts up to agents, hooks and skills, and ships copy-paste templates you can drop into a project. READMEs are available in English, Chinese, Japanese, Vietnamese and Ukrainian, making it a fit for developers who want to move from typing claude to orchestrating workflows over a weekend.

item.title: [juejin] 我用 REA 逆向了付费颜色 APP，结果很意外！
item.description: The post first explains what reverse engineering is and introduces REA, an open-source project that has drawn attention on GitHub, then uses it with AI against a single-player Android game and a learning app. It suits readers who want a hands-on look at where AI-assisted reverse engineering actually lands, rather than a purely conceptual overview.

item.title: [juejin] 手机到底有没有偷听我们？我抓包了 72 小时，抓到了真凶
item.description: A developer captured 72 hours of phone traffic and found zero microphone wake-ups at the hardware level, which weakens the "my phone is listening" theory. The uncanny precognition instead traces to public NAT spatio-temporal hypergraphs (ST-GNN), modern private set intersection (PSI), and on-device micro-model feature vectorization. Useful for engineers who want to understand how targeting actually works and where the privacy line sits.

item.description: Pollen Robotics published the onboard software for Microduck, a roughly 25 cm, 800 g bipedal duck robot. Its brain is a handful of daemons on a Rockchip RK3566: a 50 Hz control loop driving fifteen servos from neural policies, plus the radios, camera, and update machinery that pushes new software without bricking the robot. Training code for the reinforcement learning policies lives in a separate microduck_rl repo.

item.description: A Zhihu question asking why Alibaba and Tencent sit at low valuations while their share prices keep falling. item.title: [juejin] 基于 Pi，我居然自己搞了一个好用的 AI Agent 桌面工作台
item.description: A Juejin post describes how the author built an AI Agent desktop workbench on top of Pi. Its main argument is not to reinvent the wheel: the model calls, message loop, tool protocol and permission system do not need to be written from scratch. It is aimed at developers who want their own agent desktop tool without rebuilding the plumbing first.

item.title: [juejin] 副业搞起来，小说，漫画，漫剧的成本优化思路
item.description: A Juejin post laying out cost-optimization ideas for a side business built on novels, comics and comic-style shorts, linking the GitHub project aiskyhub/novel_to_comic for turning novels into comics. It suits indie developers monetizing AI-generated content who need generation and inference costs to stay under their margins.

item.title: [github_trending] jbiaojerry/ebook-treasure-chest
item.description: This GitHub repo aggregates ebook download links collected from various ebook sites, sorted by tags such as literature, history, management and tech, with each title offered in epub, mobi and azw3. Its sources cover much of the catalog of 帆书 (formerly 樊登读书), 微信读书, 京东读书 and 喜马拉雅. A GitHub Pages front end adds real-time multi-keyword search, which beats scrolling the repo if you read across devices and formats.

item.title: [juejin] AI 都会写代码了，还要不要学传统编程了? （强烈建议阅读）
item.description: Writing on 掘金, author 狂师 splits programming skill in the AI era into two tracks: non-technical people need to "use" — grasp basic concepts, state requirements clearly and do light acceptance checks — while engineers need to "judge", keeping syntax fundamentals but shifting focus to reading AI-generated code and assessing its quality and risk. His claim is simple: let AI write, keep the responsibility human.

item.title: [github_trending] google-gemini/gemini-cli
item.description: Gemini CLI is Google's open-source terminal AI agent, distributed as the npm package @google/gemini-cli. A notice atop the README says the CLI was replaced by Antigravity CLI on June 18, 2026 for unpaid-tier and Google One users, and that it hasn't been optimized for Gemini 4 Argon — that model requires Antigravity instead. Anyone who wired gemini-cli into scripts or terminal workflows should check the migration path.

item.title: [github_trending] aws/agent-toolkit-for-aws
item.description: Agent Toolkit for AWS bundles AWS-supported MCP servers, skills and plugins that give coding agents the tools, knowledge and guardrails to build, deploy and manage applications on AWS. AWS says it works with agents developers already use, including Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Devin, Kiro and fx. You can drive it from the terminal via aws configure agent-toolkit, and the Claude Code plugins ship through Anthropic's official marketplace. It's GA under Apache 2.0.
